basic_details.job_title: ECHS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 DEO/ Clerk, Nursing Assistant and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: ECHS Polyclinic Cooch Behar has 3 contractual vacancies, one each for Officer-in-Charge, Nursing Assistant and DEO/ Clerk, at a fixed remuneration of 95,000.00, 36,500./- and 29,200/- respectively. The engagement is for one year, renewable subject to conditions, and each post requires 05 years of experience. Station HQ (ECHS Cell) Binnaguri Cantt of the Ex-Servicemen Contributary Health Scheme, Ministry of Defence, must receive the application by 30 November 2026.

important_dates.interview_date: 2nd week of Dec 2026 (exact date to be intimated via tele call and email)

how_to_apply: Get the application format from the website www.echs.gov.in.
Complete the application in the requisite format, in duplicate.
Attach self attested photocopies of testimonials in support of Educational qualifications and Work Experiences.
Submit the application to OIC, Stn HQs (ECHS Cell) Binnaguri so that it is received by 30 November 2026.
Any application received after 30 November 2026 will not be accepted. The notice does not specify whether the application should go by post or by hand.

For additional details, contact Stn HQ (ECHS Cell) Binnaguri at Mobile No 6005973412 or [email protected]. The letterhead also gives the phone numbers 9682592394/6005973412. Candidates may also approach the concerned ECHS Polyclinic for details.
important_instructions: The selected individual will have to undergo 10 days on the job training (OJT) and obtain a certificate from OIC Polyclinic before signing the contract. The OJT period will remain unpaid and is counted as mandatory before assuming charge as a contractual employee. 10 days of handing/taking over will be carried out between the key appointments (OIC, Nursing Assistant, DEO/ Clerk) at the polyclinic. The Annual Property Return (Declaration of Assets) in respect of Dental Officer, covering immovable and movable property, will be deposited with Stn HQ, Binnaguri before tenanting the appointment. This requirement applies to both initial appointment and extension of tenure. The appointment/extension letter will be issued only after submission of the said document.

content_sections.heading: About ECHS
content_sections.text: The Ex-Servicemen Contributary Health Scheme (ECHS) is a health scheme under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India. This employment notice comes from its Station HQ (ECHS Cell) at Binnaguri Cantt. The notice covers Medical, Para Medical and Non Medical Staff for ECHS Polyclinic Cooch Behar.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 3 vacancies, one for each post, all at ECHS Polyclinic Cooch Behar.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Preference will be given to the Ex-servicemen. The notice states that only candidates meeting the Qualitive Requirement may apply. The official notification gives the post-wise eligibility, and the notice directs candidates to www.echs.gov.in for the Terms & Condition.

rows.minimum_qualification: GNM Diploma/ Class-I Nursing Assistants Course (Armed Forces)
Graduate/ Class I Clerical Trade (Armed Forces)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: All three posts carry a fixed remuneration, as shown in the vacancy table. The notice does not specify whether the amount is monthly, and it directs candidates to www.echs.gov.in for remuneration details. The engagement is on a contractual basis for one year. It is renewable for an additional period of one year/ till attaining the maximum age, subject to performance of candidates/other conditions. The notice does not state the maximum age.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ECHS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Get the application format from the website www.echs.gov.in . Complete the application in the requisite format, in duplicate. Attach self attested photocopies of testimonials in support of Educational qualifications and Work Experiences. Submit the application to OIC, Stn HQs (ECHS Cell) Binnaguri so that it is received by 30 November 2026 . Any application received after 30 November 2026 will not be accepted. The notice does not specify whether the application should go by post or by hand. For additional details, contact Stn HQ (ECHS Cell) Binnaguri at Mobile No 6005973412 or [email protected] . The letterhead also gives the phone numbers 9682592394/6005973412. Candidates may also approach the concerned ECHS Polyclinic for details.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection has two stages in the notice: an eligibility check by the BOO, then an interview. Eligibility check: The BOO identifies the candidates found eligible as per the laid down QR. Interview: The interview is to be held in the 2nd week of December 2026. Eligible candidates will be intimated the date, time and place via tele call and email. Travel cost: No TA/DA is admissible. Candidates must bring the following at the time of interview: All the original certificates/mark sheets/degree of 10th/matric, 10+2 and Graduation/post graduation/diploma/course Work experience documents Discharge book PPO Service records 02 (two) PP size colour photographs

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ECHS Polyclinic Cooch Behar?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Officer-in-Charge, 1 Nursing Assistant and 1 DEO/ Clerk.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must be received by 30 November 2026. Any application received after that date will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for these ECHS posts?
faq.answer: Officer-in-Charge requires Defence Officer drawing pension, Graduate. Nursing Assistant requires GNM Diploma/ Class-I Nursing Assistants Course (Armed Forces), and DEO/ Clerk requires Graduate/ Class I Clerical Trade (Armed Forces), with 05 years of experience for each post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for these ECHS Cooch Behar posts?
faq.answer: The fixed remuneration is 95,000.00 for Officer-in-Charge, 36,500./- for Nursing Assistant and 29,200/- for DEO/ Clerk.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for these ECHS posts?
faq.answer: Use the format given on www.echs.gov.in and prepare the application in duplicate with self attested photocopies of testimonials for Educational qualifications and Work Experiences. Submit it to OIC, Stn HQs (ECHS Cell) Binnaguri by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates found eligible by the BOO as per the laid down QR will be intimated about an interview via tele call and email. The interview is to be held in the 2nd week of December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job, and how long is the contract?
faq.answer: The posts are on a contractual basis for one year. The term is renewable for an additional period of one year/ till attaining the maximum age, subject to performance of candidates/other conditions.

faq.question: Q8. Do Ex-servicemen get preference?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice states that preference will be given to the Ex-servicemen.

faq.question: Q9. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA is admissible.

faq.question: Q10. Is the on the job training paid?
faq.answer: No. The 10 days of on the job training will remain unpaid and is mandatory before assuming charge as a contractual employee.
